title: Put discipline on the body
summary: Contentment, humility, and meditation make discipline plain and believable. Wear humility as discipline the body can remember.
takeaway: Wear humility as discipline the body can remember.
lifeApplication: Before your routine becomes display, choose the practice that puts contentment, humility, and remembrance into the body.
